[Intro: rolling piano motif, birdsong, soft shaker]

[Section A: deep house kick enters, warm bass, piano continues]

[Build: strings rising, wooden percussion, filter opening]

[Drop: full beat, piano motif an octave up, strings wide]

I stay

producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, F# minor with a hopeful major lift in the drops. Steady, soft and flowing melodic deep house.

VOICE: Female, airy and wordless for most of the track, used like a string line. She sings one four-word phrase twice, softly, with long reverb. No verses and no chorus in the usual sense.

INSTRUMENTS: A rolling grand-piano motif of eight notes, a soft four-on-the-floor kick, a warm rounded bass, a string section that swells slowly, wooden percussion and shakers, a kalimba, a light open hi-hat, birdsong and wind in palm leaves.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano and birds. 0:20 Section A, kick and bass. 0:46 Wordless vocal. 1:04 Build. 1:18 Drop 1. 1:44 The sung phrase. 1:56 Section B, piano and kalimba. 2:16 Build. 2:28 Drop 2. 3:00 Outro, piano slowing, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2018 melodic deep house: warm, clean and spacious, piano and strings in front, kick soft, nature sounds woven in.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The piano motif jumping an octave at the first drop, 1:18.

STATION FIT: 8 a.m., the quiet hour after the opening instrumental. It is the closest track in the pack to what SiriusXM Chill plays most: melodic, piano-led and nearly wordless.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Still, watching, lifted, still.
